_note: BMW photos from the shared 'bmw split' folder: background removed with rembg (u2net) and saved as PNG, then encoded once to WebP at the original pixel size (<= 49 KB). Paint colour was checked from the pixels; black, grey, silver, white and blue are used, and red, yellow, orange, green, gold and violet cars only where a generation exists in no other colour. Pools: model|generation -> view (45, side, front) -> [file, colour]. Heroes: the client's model-page line-up scenes (scene) and a crop of each for card slots (card). Generation heroes: one 45-degree cut-out per generation and the same car standing on the floor of BMW's light and dark backgrounds (scene, 1200x800). Engines: the shared 'BMW Engines - No Background' cut-outs at 540px. The shared B47D20A/B photo is the same picture as the N47D20C one, so B47 slots use the B47D20D photo.
